# ruru

> A pull request reviewer for code written by AI agents. For a Python change it runs a tamper audit of the tests
> (removed, loosened or skipped), fail first (do the new tests fail without the change?) and mutants on the changed
> lines (would the tests catch a planted bug?). Deterministic: no model calls, no API keys, standard library only.
> Command `ruru`, PyPI `ruru-review`, GitHub Action `jpsanders/ruru-review`, MCP server `ruru mcp`.

## Use it before you say a change is done

1. `ruru check --json ruru-report.json` (the working tree against main; `--base` names another branch).
2. For each item with `outcome: survived`, write a test that fails with the mutant (`before` changed to `after` at
   `file:line`) and passes without it. For `passes_without_change`, assert what the change adds. For each tamper
   finding, restore the test.
3. `ruru verify <id>` until each survivor is killed. Never weaken, skip or delete a test to pass.
4. Exit codes: 0 pass or advice, 1 the gate failed, 2 ruru could not test the project.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jpsanders/ruru-review/blob/main/README.md): what it catches, install, Action, agents
- [Manual](https://github.com/jpsanders/ruru-review/blob/main/docs/MANUAL.md): every command, rule, operator,
  the report schema `ruru.report/1` and configuration (`ruru guide` prints it)
- [Skill](https://github.com/jpsanders/ruru-review/blob/main/skills/ruru/SKILL.md): the agent loop
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jpsanders/ruru-review/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working in this repository

## MCP tools

`ruru_check`, `ruru_survivors`, `ruru_explain`, `ruru_verify`, `ruru_audit`. Configure with
`{"command": "uvx", "args": ["--from", "ruru-review", "ruru", "mcp"]}`.
